note: Made by the steps in TV_PICTURES.md: the surah is split into sections that each carry one deep meaning ("sections"), 10 picture ideas are written for each, the top two for each picture are made and the better is chosen by eye. Quran pictures (Obay, 2026-11-22): the Prophet Muhammad is never shown in any way, nor anyone standing in for him; God is never pictured; no religious symbols of any tradition (no mosque, minaret, dome, crescent, Arabic writing or copy of the Quran). Wide pictures only. Each scene starts at the first word of its verse, or at its "from" words inside the verse. The important part of every picture sits in the upper two thirds, clear of the words.

sections.meaning: All praise belongs to God, the merciful Lord of every world, who will be master of the Day of Judgment.
ideas: First light of dawn pouring across a vast land of mountains, rivers, forests and a far city, all lit by the same sun
The Earth seen from space as the line of sunrise sweeps across oceans and continents
The Milky Way arching over a quiet desert valley, countless stars above the hills
Warm rain falling over wide green farmland with sunlight breaking through behind it
A flock of birds rising together over a calm sea at sunrise
People of many lands on a hilltop lifting their faces to the morning light
Sun rays breaking through clouds onto a valley of villages and fields
A great balance scale standing level in morning light
A mother bending over a sleeping newborn in soft light
Waves of wheat bending in the wind under an enormous sky

sections.meaning: We serve only you and ask only you for help: lead us on the straight path of those you have blessed, not the path of those who went astray.
ideas: A man kneels alone in an open field at sunrise, palms open and lifted, face raised
A woman kneels by a window at dawn, head bowed, hands open in her lap
A straight path runs across a wide plain directly toward the rising sun
A straight path leads toward the light while faint side tracks wander off into fog
A hiker at a fork in a mountain trail, one way clear and lit, the other lost in mist
A guide's rope stretched straight up a snowy ridge with climbers following it
Footprints of many walkers along a straight sandy track through dunes
A lamp-lit path through a dark forest
A child holding a parent's hand on a straight country road
A lighthouse beam pointing the way across dark water

candidates.principle: Praise belongs to God, Lord of the worlds, the Most Merciful.
candidates.shows: First light of dawn pouring across a vast land of mountains, rivers, forests and a far city, all lit by the same sun.
candidates.prompt: A breathtaking high view at sunrise over a vast land: ranges of mountains, a winding river shining like gold, dark forests, green farmland and, far off, a small city, all touched by the same warm first light of the sun rising behind the peaks. Long soft rays fall across everything, mist lifting from the valleys, the sky glowing from rose to clear blue. Peaceful, immense and generous. The sunrise and the lit land fill the upper two thirds of the picture.

candidates.principle: Praise belongs to God, Lord of the worlds, the Most Merciful.
candidates.shows: The Earth seen from space as the line of sunrise sweeps across oceans and continents.
candidates.prompt: The Earth seen from high orbit: a great blue curve of ocean, white clouds and green and brown land, with the line of sunrise sweeping across it and the sun just breaking over the edge in a burst of golden light. Above, the black of space with a few bright stars. Majestic, calm and full of light. The Earth's curve and the sunrise are in the upper two thirds of the picture; below them the planet's surface continues in soft shadow.

candidates.principle: It is you we worship, and it is you we ask for help.
candidates.shows: A man kneels alone in an open field at sunrise, palms open and lifted, face raised.
candidates.prompt: A man in plain everyday work clothes kneels alone in a wide open field of short grass at sunrise. He is seen from the side, his face lifted toward the sky and both hands raised in front of him with the palms open and empty, asking. The low sun lights him warmly and a vast clear sky opens above. Nothing else around him but the field and the sky: a single person turning to the one he serves. No buildings. He and the sky above him fill the upper two thirds of the picture.

candidates.principle: It is you we worship, and it is you we ask for help.
candidates.shows: A woman kneels by a window at dawn, head bowed, hands open in her lap.
candidates.prompt: In a simple quiet room at dawn, a woman in plain everyday clothes kneels on a bare wooden floor beside a tall window, seen from the side. Her head is bowed and her two hands rest open in front of her, palms up, as she asks for help. Soft first light falls through the window across her and the floor. The room is plain and empty apart from her: no pictures, no objects of worship, no writing. She and the window light are in the upper two thirds of the picture.

candidates.principle: Guide us to the straight path, the path of those you have favored.
candidates.shows: A straight path runs across a wide plain directly toward the rising sun.
candidates.prompt: A narrow, straight earth path, worn smooth by many feet, runs perfectly straight across a wide grassy plain toward the horizon, where the sun is rising in a clear golden sky. The path narrows to a point in the light. Dew on the grass on either side catches the sun. Calm, sure and hopeful. The path's far end and the sunrise are in the upper two thirds of the picture; the near part of the path and the grass fill the bottom.

candidates.principle: The straight path, not the way of those who have gone astray.
candidates.shows: A straight path leads toward the light while faint side tracks wander off into fog.
candidates.prompt: A straight, clear stone path runs ahead through a misty moor toward a bright patch of morning sunlight on the horizon. On both sides, faint winding side tracks branch off the path and wander away into thick grey fog, where they disappear. The straight path is lit; the wandering tracks fade into the gloom. The path, the light ahead and the side tracks vanishing into the fog are in the upper two thirds of the picture.
